# Fixture provenance

Change `kit-api-sync-0-27`, design D10. The response fixtures under `responses/` are bare JSON bodies (no envelope), as before. Request inputs are those the fixtures echo (`address`, `base`, `quote`, `depth`, `amount`, `source`, `destination`, `asset`) or the defaults the body shows (`limit`, `window`).

Recorded: unpaid, read-only `GET` requests to `https://api.criptonlabs.com` on 2026-11-24 (about 09:49 UTC), `network: mainnet production`, API 0.27.0 (main `8bbad8ca`; `GET /openapi.json` sha256 `dd006ecba554ed303d3dae96343a44209d65d7a5744c05bc32cd32c420f0c177`, equal to the committed `tests/fixtures/openapi.json`), without any payment header, credential or SIWX proof. Bodies are the parsed production JSON, pretty-printed.
